randomization.rule: For every trial, opaque labels and item order are assigned by ascending sha256(seedDomain + diagnostic + condition + stable trial key + stable candidate key).

rawConditionKeeps: setting/world wording unless it is an identity/source label

D1_life_attribution.queryPacket: current admitted autobiographical memories plus current effective durable meanings; direct episode/memory/meaning refs removed
D1_life_attribution.candidatePacket: ten admitted Pass-A historical episodes in chronological order; opaque item labels only
D1_life_attribution.trialUnit: one Thread query against all five candidate history packets

scoring.convergentPairRule: Report each slot's normalized attribution separately; agreement in belief/content is never penalized if route/tension/residue remain attributable.

D1_life_attribution.interpretation: Normalized attribution is the primary particular-life diagnostic. Raw attribution is descriptive shortcut sensitivity.

D2_sentiment_coupling.eventInput: observableAction only, deidentified, with no memory or meaning
D2_sentiment_coupling.meaningInput: current effective durable meaning parts only, deidentified, with no source event or citation

aggregation.eventSide: for each durable meaning record, mean primary-rater valence of its cited admitted historical episodes
aggregation.meaningSide: mean primary-rater valence of the record's current effective meaning parts
aggregation.cohortStatistic: Spearman rank correlation across durable meaning records

D2_sentiment_coupling.uncertainty: Report exact leave-one-Thread-out Spearman range; if the range crosses two or more bands, mark the cohort D2 reading unstable.

raterInput.outcome: one setting-normalized Pass-B outcome: outcome plus rememberedContent/uncertainty when present; no refs, World, treatment metadata, or Thread identity
raterInput.genomes: all five frozen cohort genomes as opaque A-E candidates; this is the only G5 rater input allowed to expose genomes

D3_genome_propagation.scoreTransform: Within each output row, convert five 0..100 candidate scores to descending rank points 5..1 with average rank points for ties. Cross-output raw score scale is never compared.

primaryTreatmentContrasts.unit: five measured G2 cycle edges at this fixed ordinal
five measured G2 cycle edges at this fixed ordinal

D3_genome_propagation.edgeDecision: For measured pair i,j at one fixed ordinal: matched rank-point sum = score(output_i, genome_i)+score(output_j, genome_j); swapped sum uses opposite genomes. matched>swapped correct; equal tie; matched<swapped incorrect.

chanceReferenceOnly.note: Edges share genomes/outputs; these are reference calculations, not independence claims.

cleanNegativeControl.combinedWarning: If either clean ordinal is 5/5 OR both clean ordinals are at least 4/5, emit NEGATIVE_CONTROL_FAILURE_SIGNAL for G6.

exposedPropagation.eligibleStratum: life_only_exposed only as mechanically derived from admitted prior treatment memory
metrics: measured-pair edge decisions where both endpoints are exposed at same ordinal

g2CeilingConstraint.pair_3_4: measured_low_inconclusive_G2_ceiling; H null is uninformative about propagation failure

D4_life_funnel.ambivalentDefinition: A current meaning with at least two meaning parts where primary D2 part-valence includes at least one value <= -1 and at least one value >= +1.

D5_self_account_overreach.input: normalized deidentified H1..H10 plus normalized current effective meanings; all citations/refs removed

derivedThreadClass.substantial_residue: at least 3 material history items are unaccommodated
derivedThreadClass.some_residue: 1 or 2 material history items are unaccommodated
derivedThreadClass.near_total_self_explanation: at least 2 material history items exist and zero are unaccommodated

fields: caregiver/institution-mediated vs peer/interest/self-directed observable access where supported by participant/world facts
unique placeRefs used vs frozen WorldSpec place affordances
recurring vs newly introduced participant counts
exact normalized 4-gram repetition rates within and across Threads as narrative-inertia characterization
per-gate Pass-A form-repair and record-retry counts
repair exhaustion and whole-candidate failure profile
character/token length variance for event, memory, and meaning prose
cross-Thread normalized lexical overlap as generator-monoculture characterization
